summary.text: Samantha Mota is a Democratic candidate who placed second in the June 2026 top-two primary and faces fellow Democrat Sydney Kamlager-Dove in the general election. She describes her campaign as grassroots and community-focused. In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey she named immigration reform, universal health care, family leave, and economic stability as policy areas she is passionate about; little other biographical information is public.

paragraphs.text: Placed second in the June 2, 2026 nonpartisan primary with 11.7% of the vote (15,019 votes), advancing to a same-party general election against incumbent Sydney Kamlager-Dove.

In her 2025 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, she describes her campaign as grassroots, community focused, and transparent, and says she is running because of a lack of new and transparent leadership in politics.
